plan.goal: Retrieve a function-matched NAD(P)HX epimerase family, summarize the family, and return a representative protein sequence candidate for NAD(P)HX epimerization under Mg(2+)-relevant metal-binding constraints.
assumptions: The request combines activities that are often split across the NAD(P)HX repair system; this plan prioritizes the NAD(P)HX epimerase family because epimerization of S- and R-NAD(P)HX is the core catalytic requirement stated.

With the provided validated tools, the executable fallback is family-sequence retrieval plus sequence summarization, then returning a representative candidate sequence from the retrieved epimerase family rather than performing de novo active-site engineering.

Mg(2+) dependence, ATP/AMP handling, and ligand accessibility will be treated as family-level selection criteria inferred from literature and annotations; they are not directly structure-validated in this tool set.
